structuralResponse.boardsWentFromThreeToFour: the first shape crammed the occupancy matrix and the three declined classes into a sidebar beside an 18-row register. Rendering showed it does not fit, and the honest reading was not that the layout was wrong but that two arguments were sharing a board. The refusals became their own board (Declined.dc.html): the matrix is the drawing of why the band vocabulary exists, and refusing occupancyCount is what makes the band vocabulary, so the matrix and the three refused fields are ONE argument and now sit together.
structuralResponse.boardsConsideredAndCut: Empty.dc.html. On empty-city both regions return the identical no-grant sentence, which says strictly less than the Bastrop board where one status produces two different sentences. Repeating the Public works five-state legend would be padding.
structuralResponse.placementLeftTheDeviceTable: the domain derives sites once so a site's placement is stable across every camera mounted on it, and the shipped table repeats it on all 18 device rows. Moving it to the site table is a proposed change, stated in the basis and in the README, not a silent redraw.

adversarialReviewOfTheInstrument.howItWasReviewed: not by reading it. By planting defects in real artboards one at a time and confirming each fails with the expected reason, then restoring and proving restoration by md5.
adversarialReviewOfTheInstrument.firstRun: 12 of 15 caught, 1 anchor missing, 2 MISSED. The two misses were instrument defects, not harness problems.
adversarialReviewOfTheInstrument.defectOne: THE PLATE RULE WAS BLINDED BY ITS OWN EXCLUSION SET. The candidate regex could span separators; the rule then excluded a whole candidate if any run inside it matched a declared composer format. So a plate next to a record id joined into one candidate, the record id excluded it, and 'FIX-CAM-1007 7XYZ123' passed the strongest rule on this lens. An exclusion whose scope is wider than its claim. Fixed by removing the composer's own identifiers as EXACT STRINGS first and matching plate forms against the remainder.
adversarialReviewOfTheInstrument.defectTwo: THE BADGE RULE WAS SCOPED TO THE LENS BODY AND THE NAV IS OUTSIDE IT. An invented state word in the sidebar was on the canvas and unchecked. Badges, surveillance terms, plates, money and vendor names now read the whole document; pairs, cells, ids, matrix cells and occupancies stay body-scoped.
adversarialReviewOfTheInstrument.bothAreSelfTestsNow: six self-tests were added for the two defects, because a fix nobody can watch fail is not a fix.
adversarialReviewOfTheInstrument.secondRun: 17 of 17 caught, all four artboards restored byte-identical, baseline re-run exit 0.

narrownessesClosed.vendorNamesInProse: the earlier lens checks verify only the structured provenance foot. This one lifts every source-state string out of the board text first, then requires every catalogued vendor display name left in the prose to be one of this lens's two gates. Quotation stays legal and is self-tested in both directions.
narrownessesClosed.bigFiguresAtNonKitWeight: the Parks rule is font:[45]00 at 20px+. This one matches ANY three-digit weight at 20px+ in either font AND requires every big figure's text to be a number the composer produced. Self-tested against a 370-weight invented figure in both fonts.

twoCollisionsBetweenTheProductAndITSELF: THE MONEY GATE REFUSES TWO OF THE PRODUCT'S OWN NOTATIONS. FORBIDDEN_CONTENT matches any currency symbol anywhere, so a template literal's ${...} slot and a regex's $ end anchor both trip it. Quoting a sentence template or a declared format character for character would put a money token on a lens that prints none. RESOLVED BY REWRITING THE NOTATION, NOT BY WIDENING THE RULE: slots render in angle brackets, the operator format is written out in words, the boards say so, and check.mjs applies the same transform to the source string so the comparison stays two-sided. Admitting a known bad value to make a check pass is the move this programme keeps paying for.

THE COUNTING RULE FOR AN ABSENCE IS ITS BASIS WITH A PREFIX. Verified: composeDomain sets countingRule to 'no records: ' + basis exactly, for all four absences this design draws. Printing both is printing one sentence twice, so the boards print the basis and say why the counting rule is not repeated. gen.mjs asserts the identity so the sentence breaks if the seam changes.
